decision: Define supported codes once as SGD and CAD; remove USD from configuration, selector, FX response, copy, and project docs
evidence: All currency config and UI references; runtime GET /api/config returned supportedCurrencies ["sgd","cad"]
result: No active USD reference remains; unsupported explicit currency rejected with HTTP 400

decision: Require a unique client_ref and send it as Omise ref_id
evidence: Omise Charges API documents ref_id as a duplicate-charge protection reference; both card and Apple Pay flows generate UUID refs
result: Both frontend charge paths supply a reference; payload includes it

decision: Resolve CF-Connecting-IP only from Cloudflare peer ranges at Nginx; application consumes validated X-Real-IP only
evidence: Official Cloudflare guidance says configure ngx_http_realip_module with trusted Cloudflare prefixes and keep them updated
result: Untrusted request body and direct forwarding-header fallbacks removed; CIDR maintenance and origin firewall remain operational requirements

decision: Keep SGD/CAD reference conversions but label the market quote indicative and disclose Omise/issuer rates can differ
evidence: Omise SG Multi-Currency docs distinguish Omise settlement conversion from issuer conversion
result: UI no longer implies reference quote is the charge/settlement rate

decision: Keep the existing manual capture/3DS guard unchanged
evidence: Omise SG 3DS is account-level and issuer/bank decides frictionless or challenge; current account settings not available here

decision: Keep existing merchant-side cap and document account-specific funding/FX limitation
evidence: Omise SG currency docs state limits apply to SGD funding amount; account-specific configured limits not available here
result: Dashboard/account-team confirmation remains required before production cap tuning

decision: Build production artifacts and query served config plus unsupported USD request
evidence: npm run build; GET /api/config; POST /api/charge with currency usd
result: Build passed; config exposes SGD/CAD; USD request returns unsupported_currency before contacting Omise

decision: Remove the preselected US country and label the card address as Cardholder Billing Country; require a real country selection
evidence: Cardholder billing country is tokenized and used for AVS; Customer address is independently collected
result: Prevents silent US defaults from misrepresenting either party's address

decision: Remove high-value anti-fraud/approval guarantee and Level 2 claims from UI/README; describe local AVS format checks accurately
